extracted.name: Chicken Eugene
extracted.description: Mushroom sauce coats bacon-wrapped chicken nestled on a bed of dried beef. This recipe is doubled or tripled easily to feed all comers.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees F (135 degrees C).
Line a 9x13 inch glass baking dish with dried beef. Wrap chicken breasts with bacon strips; place on top of dried beef.
Combine cream of mushroom soup and sour cream in a bowl; pour evenly over chicken.
Bake in the preheated oven for 3 hours.
